run_openai_embedding_matryoshka_fy_clien: run the OpenAI client to generate Matryoshka embeddings with configurable dimensions from vLLM server
create_openai_client_vllm: create an OpenAI client configured to connect to a vLLM API server for embedding generation
list_available_models: list available models from the vLLM server using the OpenAI client models endpoint
create_matryoshka_embeddings: create embeddings with custom Matryoshka dimensions from the vLLM embedding API
run_embedding_client_main: run the main embedding client script to generate truncated embeddings from input text
